title: ihris-skill-artefacts/v1
description: The kinds of data this folio holds, ONE definition each: where it lives (`default`, a repository path or glob), what its records are (`x-records`, a $schema tag) or its media type, and where it is published (`x-published`). Every skill's input and output contract references these by $ref, and every Tool's io port names one by its IRI, so a skill, the Tools that perform it and the workflow diagram generated from them (src/tools/gen_workflow.py) agree on one name per artefact. The cat-harness skills-and-tools practice: a skill names its contracts in its front matter (input:, output:).
